rule.bridge.show_trick_count.description: Display the current trick number on the table screen.
rule.bridge.enable_bots.description: Seats nobody is sitting in are taken by AI players, so a single person can start a table. Turn this off to require four real players.
rule.bridge.vulnerable.description: Score the board as if the side that wins the auction were vulnerable: bigger game and slam bonuses, and bigger penalties when the contract goes down.
rule.bridge.bot_strength.description: Easy: follows suit and bids on points alone. Normal: plays to the seat and the trick, and bids a real system. Hard: rolls the trick out before playing and hunts slams. Click to cycle.
strength.bridge.easy.description: Plays the first card that follows suit and bids on high card points alone.
strength.bridge.normal.description: Plays to the seat and the current trick, and bids a full system.
strength.bridge.hard.description: Rolls the rest of the trick out before choosing, hunts slams and doubles for penalties.
message.bridge.game_started: A new board of Contract Bridge. Good luck!
message.bridge.illegal_call: %s is not available, counted as a pass
message.bridge.passed_out: Four passes: the board is passed out and dealt again.
message.bridge.dummy_is: %s is the dummy: their hand is face up and declarer plays it.
message.bridge.your_turn_dummy: Your turn - play a card from the dummy
message.bridge.even_teams: Contract Bridge needs an even number of players so the partnerships are fair.
message.bridge.double_dummy_result: [double dummy] %s by %s: with both sides playing perfectly the declaring side can take at most %s tricks and the contract needs %s - %s (this board took %s)%s
editor.bridge.hint: F9 close/edit | drag move | scroll scale | R reset | Ctrl+R reset all (config/bridge-layout.properties)
